title: Votic for English speakers
description: A small starter course for learning about Votic. The sample vocabulary needs review by a fluent Votic speaker.

units.title: Greetings & first words
units.topic: Difficulty 1 · Begin with the starter words included in this course.
units.notes:
## Starter vocabulary

| Votic | English |
| --- | --- |
| tere | hi / hello |
| miä õõn | I am |

> These starter examples are provided for demonstration and should be checked by a Votic speaker before being used as authoritative language instruction.

questions.prompt: Which Votic word is listed as ‘hi / hello’ in the notes?
